site.title: Hyeon Jun Lim
site.description: Senior Research Engineer at Hyundai Motor Company. Reinforcement learning, end-to-end planning, and LiDAR perception for autonomous driving.

profile.name: Hyeon Jun Lim
profile.affiliation: Autonomous Driving Development, Hyundai Motor Company
bio: I am a Senior Research Engineer in the Autonomous Driving Development division at Hyundai Motor Company, with 7+ years of experience spanning robotics research and production-grade autonomous platforms.

My work centers on reinforcement learning, Transformer-based end-to-end planning, and high-reliability decision-making for self-driving vehicles. I architect closed-loop simulation environments, build LiDAR-based perception and 3D reconstruction systems, and take algorithms all the way onto real vehicles.

Previously, I built South Korea's first large-scale, high-precision LiDAR dataset for autonomous driving (1M+ labeled objects) at KITECH, and designed LiDAR simulation frameworks for sensor development, HD mapping, and high-fidelity 3D scanning. My academic foundation is in T-S fuzzy-based robust control and state estimation from Yonsei University.

projects.title: Unified Closed-Loop Simulation Framework for RL-Based Autonomous Driving
projects.summary: Built a closed-loop RL training stack — 3DGS photorealistic environments, rule-driven reward modeling, and World-Model synthetic data — and deployed the resulting driving policies on physical vehicles.

projects.title: End-to-End Autonomous Planning System
projects.summary: Led development, embedded deployment, and real-world validation of a Transformer-based end-to-end planner, including its first-ever on-vehicle control.

projects.title: Lv.3 / Lv.4 Autonomous Driving Perception Systems (HDP & Robo-Services)
projects.summary: Led the company's LiDAR perception stack — sensor evaluation, clustering, localization, and online calibration — validated on Genesis G90, Kia EV9, and the Robo-services fleet.

projects.title: River Management Technology Using a Drone-Based Survey Platform
projects.summary: Built a high-fidelity LiDAR simulation framework to derive hardware specifications and validate dual-wavelength bathymetric sensing for river and subsurface mapping.

projects.title: Standardized Open Database and Evaluation System for Intelligent Vehicle Perception
projects.summary: Built South Korea's first large-scale 128-channel LiDAR dataset for autonomous driving — over a million labeled objects, automated annotation, and cm-level HD mapping.

projects.title: 3D Vehicle Shape Generation System for Automated Car Wash
projects.summary: Developed a sub-2 cm-accuracy multi-LiDAR vehicle-profiling system for unmanned car-wash automation, running in real time on TI embedded hardware.

demos.title: 128-Channel LiDAR Annotation Viewer
demos.project: Standardized Open Database and Evaluation System for Intelligent Vehicle Perception · KITECH, 2018–2020
demos.description: The in-house viewer used to build and verify the dataset. The top panel is a single 128-channel LiDAR sweep with 3D object boxes; the bottom panels project those same boxes into the time-synchronized front-left and rear-mid cameras. Checking the projection frame by frame is how mislabeled objects and sensor mis-calibration were caught before a sequence entered the corpus — the corpus that eventually reached over a million labeled objects.
